title: ICE agents are chasing Miami's Haitians: 'No one goes out anymore, the streets and churches are deserted'

title: 'The Trump plan changed nothing': One year later, Gaza still lives in ruins, under bombs
subhead: Three years after the Hamas attacks of October 7, 2023, residents of the Palestinian territory continue to live among rubble. title: Trauma endures in Paris suburb after police grenade shatters teenager's jaw
subhead: On September 28, 14-year-old Eden suffered a fractured jaw and lost most of his teeth after he was struck in the face by a tear-gas grenade fired at close range, just a few meters from his high school, where a protest was taking place.
